title: PTP: changing TLVs to relative offsets
description:
Making offset handling more consistent and preparing for TLV rework.

Also adding some missing Reserved fields.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • e8d770bb - PTP: changing TLVs to relative offsets
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18371/diffs?diff_id=1205128966&start_sha=02b74a8344882e76940b02b4425087c57965c8e6)

Can you fix :

`packet-ptp.c:2888:5: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]`

Done.

And I also found a place, where ENC_NA instead of ENC_BIG_ENDIAN was needed.
That looks much better to me.  Were you able to check confirm that that decodes still look good afterwards for the areas you changed?

I used a couple of traces I had, some from existing tickets, and created several traces for TLVs.

They match up, except that I added missing reserved fields and I aggregated flags to arrays and used `proto_tree_add_bitmask`, so they look a tiny bit different.

BTW.
I rewrote the TLV handling to make it much more robust and fixing a couple of bugs. As the patch was too big for gitlab diff, I am splitting into smaller patches. The next will move the TLVs out of that dissection function to make them more flexible and allow multiple TLVs everywhere - actually this is one of the bugs I try to get around.

In addition, I wrote code to register subdissectors for unknown TLVs as I need that for a TLV that - due to possible license issues - I cannot publish code for. :disappointed: 

So 1 or more patches after this will follow.
